canada.title: Quebec coroner’s report questions suicide conclusion in death of 18-year-old
canada.summary: A Quebec coroner says evidence does not establish suicide in the death of 18-year-old Emmanuel Diafouka. His family is calling for police to reopen the investigation.

canada.title: Northern Manitoba storm upgraded, could now bring 20-40 cm of snow: Environment Canada
canada.summary: Environment Canada has upgraded the special weather statement it issued on Thursday. It's now listed as a winter storm warning with the possibility of 20 to 40 centimetres of heavy snow.

canada.title: A love letter to Nova Scotians: Thank you for saying ‘no’ to EverWind’s AI data centre
canada.summary: Nova Scotians are angrier than ever. I love to see it.

canada.title: New RNC union president pushing for body-worn cameras
canada.summary: The Royal Newfoundland Constabulary Association president is publicly supporting the introduction of body-worn cameras for police in the province, with other police associations in Canada introducing camera systems. One researcher suggests the cameras are not a cure-all for public trust and the spending involved might be better directed.

canada.title: Ballots cast on election day in B.C. will be counted by hand, Elections BC says
canada.summary: It's the last full day of campaigning in British Columbia's election ahead of final voting day Saturday, when most ballots will be counted by hand.

canada.title: Advocates flag contributions, not costs, of newcomers in Alberta referendum aftermath
canada.summary: Critics have warned that the referendum's outcome could make Alberta less attractive to newcomers at a time when jobs desperately need to be filled.

canada.title: Inquest into death of Regis Korchinski-Paquet set to continue
canada.summary: A coroner's inquest into the death of a Toronto woman who fell from a highrise balcony in the presence of police is set to resume Friday morning after adjourning early on Thursday.

canada.title: Boon or boondoggle? N.S. weighs $10B data centre’s promised economic benefits
canada.summary: Living more than 200 kilometres from the site of a major artificial intelligence data centre proposal isn't stopping Michael McCluskey from voicing his opposition to the project.

canada.title: What you need to know about B.C. party platforms ahead of Saturday's election
canada.summary: B.C.'s five top parties have released campaign platforms intended to sway voters on their vision for the future of the province.

canada.title: Parks Canada plan to cut 500 jobs draws criticism from union
canada.summary: Parks Canada is restructuring its workforce following a $145-million budget cut over the next three years. The union representing the public servants said the impending layoffs are "disappointing."

canada.title: GTA cities are missing climate targets. Could the election change things?
canada.summary: Hampered by the Ontario government and the enormity of the climate crisis, Mississauga, Brampton and Toronto have struggled to meet emissions reduction goals

canada.title: Police in Terrebonne, Que., searching for 18-year-old who is deaf and nonverbal
canada.summary: The teen may exhibit behaviour similar to that of a 10-year-old, according to police, who are concerned for his health and safety

canada.title: 25 years after project first began, final stretch of Team Gushue Highway is opening Friday
canada.summary: Twenty-five years after construction started, the Newfoundland and Labrador government says the final phase of the Team Gushue Highway is opening Friday.

canada.title: As the Yukon moves to lift rent control, we asked how many MLAs are landlords
canada.summary: With rent control and no-fault evictions on the table in the Yukon legislature, CBC News asked members of the legislative assembly whether or not they’re landlords.

canada.title: Workshop in Haines Junction teaches fish canning and connects generations
canada.summary: A fish-canning workshop in Haines Junction, Yukon, helps residents preserve food while also passing knowledge between generations. Participants say the skills can help reduce food waste, save money and keep cultural traditions alive.

canada.title: Military could begin Arctic sensor installations next summer
canada.summary: National Defence plans to install 47 sensor stations across the North starting as early as next summer to bolster Norad’s surveillance and early warning abilities, according to recently published regulatory filings.

canada.title: Winnipeg couple files complaint over birth registration laws after surrogacy legal hurdles
canada.summary: It took five weeks and cost Winnipeg dads Darrel Nadeau and Mackenzie Dyck about $6,000 to get formally recognized as parents after a surrogate mother gave birth to their son, Théo.

canada.title: Both sides in fracking debate say the evidence remains clear, 12 years later
canada.summary: The evidence on either side of the fracking debate remains clear for both opponents and proponents 12 years after the provincial government imposed its moratorium on shale gas development.
